testcase.name: Scenario: Hide command labels and restore the normal ribbon appearance: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:636:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide command labels and restore the normal ribbon appearance ✔ Given a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software ✔ And Ribbon Appearance is set to Normal ✔ When the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user selects Text Off ✔ Then command labels are hidden while command icons and panel titles remain visible ✔ And the active sketch remains unchanged ✔ When the user opens Ribbon Appearance again ✔ And the user selects Normal ✔ Then command labels return to the ribbon ✔ And the active sketch remains unchanged
